assets.replacement_scope: Only child geometry under the target BranchCanopy pivot; preserve outer world model, planter sibling, seating, floor, collisions, QvPen and screen anchors.

radial rafters and trunk end bands

assets.readability_contract: The trunk rises from the existing planter; three load-bearing Y forks split into six tapered radial arms. Six ribs and cross battens support a six-panel sewn crown. Taper, fork collars, eave rails and distinct fabric/wood/metal zones identify a timber shade structure.
